board-soft-cap.rationale: BOARD.md outgrew the ~16 KB soft cap; CLEAN pruned it at v7.157.0 and the warning stopped emitting. The v7.215-v7.216 wave regrew the board and the warning returned, measured then at a 25.1 KB remainder (improve-wave ticket bodies); T-464 was closed when a later scrub dropped the board under the cap. It returned again at 8.1.0, this time as 106 closed records / 55,628 bytes that board_scrub.select reported as prunable with zero remainder: CLEAN (E-21145) scrubbed them into .saipen/recovery/board-scrub/board-scrub-d3fbd85bb75b4e9983029d74dbeeff26/BOARD.md and sealed 1,819 LOG events into .saipen/logs/LOG-020.md (E-21146); a fresh select returns due=false, pruned=0, pruned_bytes=0, so the slug no longer emits and no live owner is required -- T-401 binds ownership only while the slug emits. Kept as history, re-owns only if it returns (T-2058)

log-soft-cap.rationale: active LOG.md outgrew a cheap read; CLEAN sealed it at v7.157.0 so the warning stopped emitting -- kept as history, re-owns only if it returns
